articles.title: Monad, an Ethereum rival, offered early investors up to $60 million to cash out. Almost all said no
articles.snippet: The program came three months before investor unlocks begin, with MON trading below its public-sale price and most of the token supply still outside circulation.

articles.title: Neuberger teams with Securitize on multi-chain tokenized fixed-income fund launch
articles.snippet: The $613 billion asset manager will subadvise a high-yield fund tokenized across Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche and Sui.

articles.title: CFTC seeks public input on AI compute futures contracts as CME eyes October launch
articles.snippet: The regulatory review could shape an emerging market that lets companies and investors trade and hedge the cost of increasingly scarce AI computing power.

articles.title: Bitpanda fined in Austria’s first published MiCA penalty
articles.snippet: The FMA said Bitpanda breached MiCA rules on crypto white papers and marketing communications, with the decision now final.

articles.title: Bitpanda Hit With Europe's First Published MiCA Penalty in Austria
articles.snippet: Austria's Financial Market Authority fined the Vienna-based exchange 70,000 euros for procedural and disclosure breaches, an early marker of how EU regulators intend to enforce the bloc's new crypto rulebook.
